slides.title: Elements of Window Functions Partitioning Ordering Framing Optional
slides.text: Elements of Window Functions Partitioning Ordering Framing Optional Defines order within partition Further restrict the window partition SUM(profit) OVER( PARTITION BY country) AS country_sum SUM(profit) OVER( PARTITION BY country ORDER BY ordermonth ) AS ordered_country_sum SUM(profit) OVER(PARTITION BY country ORDER BY ordermonth ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS dynamic_country_sum Supported by all window functions & Restricts window to only certain values => Think of it as grouping Often used as tiebreaker to ensure determinism Works with aggregate & selected offset functions Only work in SELECT and ORDER BY clauses due to logical query ordering
